name: Calculator
description: Exact arithmetic for the bot: sums, percentages like 15% of 80, tips split between people, and unit conversions for length, weight, volume, temperature and speed. It only works out numbers; it does not solve equations, do algebra or convert currencies, and it stores nothing.
author: Cypher Sisters

tools.calculate: Work out arithmetic exactly: + - * / // % ** and brackets, sqrt, abs, round, min, max, pi and e, and percentages like 15% of 80 or 80 + 15%. Answers in a plain sentence.
tools.tip: Work out a tip on a bill and the total, and what each person pays when the bill is split.
tools.convert: Convert a number between units of length, weight, volume (US cups, pints, gallons), temperature or speed, like 5 miles to km or 350 F to C.

consent: Calculator runs on this computer only and uses no internet. It stores nothing.
